manifest.name: dsh-visual-safety-control
manifest.description: Windows desktop-control plugin for DeepSeek Harness: screenshot, local OCR and UI Automation with a content policy (dangerous labels / sensitive windows / secrets) and action verification (hit-test, expect, verifyText). Fork of qingying012/dsh-desktop-control (MIT).
manifest.author: XiaYuehua <2814895010@qq.com> (https://github.com/Kxiaoguai3)

bundle.text:
# dsh bundle layer: mount the desktop tool from dsh-visual-safety-control.
# Loaded by DeepSeek Harness from package.json's dsh.bundle manifest.
#
# Policy defaults and the editable settings form come from the plugin Config
# schema in dsh/index.js. Values written through Settings -> 视觉安全 are stored
# in the profile's cordis.patch.yml and override these defaults.
- insert:
    - id: visual-safety-control
      name: dsh-visual-safety-control
      config:
        verifyType: true
        verifyClick: true

DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面控制插件。给模型一个 `desktop` 工具：截图、OCR、UIA 定位控件、鼠标键盘输入，并带有内容策略和动作校验。
本仓库基于 [qingying012/dsh-desktop-control](https://github.com/qingying012/dsh-desktop-control) v0.1.3（MIT）修改。

| 能力 | 说明 |
| :-- | :-- |
| 截图 | 全屏、指定窗口或区域截图，可选坐标网格和光标标记 |
| OCR | 本地 Windows OCR，返回文字内容和坐标 |
| 找控件 | 按 OCR 文字或 UIA 控件名定位，可按窗口过滤；多命中时拒绝点击并列出候选 |
| 鼠标 | 坐标点击、UIA 控件点击、移动、拖拽、滚轮 |
| 键盘 | 文本粘贴、组合键；输入前确认窗口在前台、控件可编辑，输入后回读内容 |
| 窗口 | 列出窗口（HWND / PID / 位置 / 标题），激活指定窗口 |
| 序列 | 一次调用执行多个步骤，减少往返 |

- 危险标签（支付、转账、删除、卸载等）不点击、不查找
- 敏感窗口（银行、密码、钱包、凭据管理器）不读取、不操作
- 疑似凭据的输入内容拒绝发送
- 危险组合键拒绝执行
- 不可逆动作（发布、发送、提交、购买）默认请求用户确认

- 点击前用 `expect` 校验落点处的文字，防止坐标过期
- 点击后用 `verifyText` 校验窗口里出现预期结果
- 点击做 hit-test，支持同进程弹窗和 UWP 窗口，避免误判
- 输入后通过 UI Automation 回读，确认文字真的写进去了

本地目录：

```js
plugin_manager({ action: "install_bundle", target: "<本仓库的绝对路径>" })
```

npm（发布后）：

```js
plugin_manager({ action: "install_bundle", target: "dsh-visual-safety-control" })
```

> GitHub 仓库右侧的 **Packages** 里还有一份 `@kxiaoguai3/dsh-visual-safety-control` 镜像（由 GitHub Actions
> 自动发布到 GitHub Packages）。它只用于 GitHub 侧展示；日常安装请走上面的 npmjs 名称，GitHub Packages
> 需要额外配置 `read:packages` 凭据。

不要和 `dsh-desktop-control` 同时启用：两者都会注册名为 `desktop` 的工具，重名会导致加载失败。

| action | 作用 | 主要参数 |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `find` | OCR 定位文字并返回屏幕坐标，可直接点击 | `text` / `window` / `click` / `exact` / `index` / `threshold` |
| `elements` | UIA 控件列表（名称 + 中心坐标） | `window` / `filter` / `depth` / `all` |
| `ocr` | 对图片做 OCR | `imagePath` / `filter` |
| `screenshot` | 保存截图并返回路径 | `window` / `region` / `print` / `grid` / `cursor` / `maxWidth` |
| `windows` | 列出窗口 | `top` |
| `click` | 点击坐标或 UIA 控件 | `x` `y` / `uia` `invoke` / `window` / `expect` / `verifyText` / `button` `count` |
| `move` / `drag` / `scroll` | 移动、拖拽、滚轮 | `x` `y` / `x2` `y2` / `amount` |
| `type` | 粘贴文本 | `text` / `window` / `verify` |
| `key` | 组合键，例如 `ctrl+s` | `key` |
| `activate` | 把窗口切到前台 | `window` |
| `pos` / `wait` | 读取光标位置 / 等待 | — / `waitMs` |
| `sequence` | 一次执行多个步骤 | `steps` |

装好插件后，打开 **设置 → 视觉安全**（设置面板左侧导航里直接有这一项，排在「内置插件」下面），可以直接编辑策略：

- 启用/关闭内容策略
- 危险标签、敏感窗口、不可逆动作标签（每行一个）
- 不可逆动作的处理方式：请求确认 / 直接拒绝 / 允许
- 拒绝的快捷键、序列最大嵌套层数

点保存后写入当前 profile 的插件配置，**下一次工具调用立即生效**，不需要重启。也可以继续用 `cordis.patch.yml` 配置，两种方式等价。

> 首次安装后如果设置面板里还没看到「视觉安全」，刷新一次 Harness 页面（Ctrl+R）即可加载新的客户端插件。

```yaml
- id: visual-safety-control
  name: dsh-visual-safety-control
  config:
    policy:

策略在 PowerShell 启动前生效，模型无法通过参数关闭。用户配置里的列表会整表替换默认值。

| 选项 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 关闭后不注册工具 |
| `powershellPath` | `powershell.exe` | PowerShell 路径 |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | 单次调用超时 |
| `screenshotDir` | `$DSH_HOME/desktop-control` | 截图保存目录 |
| `screenshotMaxWidth` | `1440` | 长边上限 |
| `screenshotGrid` / `screenshotCursor` | `false` / `true` | 坐标网格 / 光标标记 |
| `keepShots` | `40` | 保留的截图数量 |
| `elementsMaxRows` | `140` | `elements` 行数上限 |
| `verifyType` / `verifyClick` | `true` | 默认开启校验 |

| 状态 | 含义 |
| :-- | :-- |
| `verified` | 输入回读包含目标文字，或 `verifyText` 在动作后找到了要求的内容 |
| `unverified` | 回读成功但内容不符，或动作后没有找到 `verifyText` |
| `unknown` | 动作已送达，但结果无法机器校验 |
| `refused` | 拒绝执行：焦点不对、切不到前台、hit-test 不匹配、`expect` 失配或策略拦截 |

- 只支持 Windows，并且需要交互式桌面会话；锁屏、UAC 安全桌面、RDP 断开会失败
- 纯坐标点击不受内容策略判断，建议配合 `expect` / `verifyText`
- 短标签或形近字 OCR 可能识别错误，用 `exact` 和 `index` 提高精度
- 不可逆动作默认 `ask`，宿主不支持审批时会直接拒绝

A Windows desktop-control plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It gives the model a `desktop` tool: screenshots, local OCR, UI Automation control lookup, mouse and keyboard input — plus a content policy and action verification.

Forked from [qingying012/dsh-desktop-control](https://github.com/qingying012/dsh-desktop-control) v0.1.3 (MIT).

| Capability | What it does |
| :-- | :-- |
| Screenshot | Full screen, window or region; optional coordinate grid and cursor mark |
| OCR | Local Windows OCR, returns text and coordinates |
| Locate | Find by OCR text or UIA control name, filtered by window; refuses to click on ambiguity and lists candidates |
| Mouse | Coordinate click, UIA control click, move, drag, scroll |
| Keyboard | Paste text, key combos; checks the target window and editability first, reads the value back |
| Windows | List windows (HWND / PID / rect / title), activate one |
| Sequence | Run several steps in one call |

- Dangerous labels (pay, delete, uninstall, …): never clicked or located
- Sensitive windows (bank, password manager, wallet, credentials): never read or driven
- Credential-looking input: refused
- Dangerous key combos: refused
- Irreversible actions (publish, send, submit, buy): ask the user first

- `expect` checks the text under the click point before clicking, catching stale coordinates
- `verifyText` checks the window after the action
- Clicks are hit-tested; same-process popups and UWP windows are handled
- Typed text is read back through UI Automation

Local checkout:

```js
plugin_manager({ action: "install_bundle", target: "<absolute path to this repo>" })
```

From npm (after publishing):

```js
plugin_manager({ action: "install_bundle", target: "dsh-visual-safety-control" })
```

Do not enable this alongside `dsh-desktop-control`: both register a tool named `desktop`, and duplicate names fail activation.

| action | Purpose | Main args |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `find` | OCR text and return screen coordinates; can click | `text` / `window` / `click` / `exact` / `index` / `threshold` |
| `elements` | UIA control list (name + centre) | `window` / `filter` / `depth` / `all` |
| `ocr` | OCR an image | `imagePath` / `filter` |
| `screenshot` | Save a PNG, return its path | `window` / `region` / `print` / `grid` / `cursor` / `maxWidth` |
| `windows` | List visible windows | `top` |
| `click` | Click a point or a UIA control | `x` `y` / `uia` `invoke` / `window` / `expect` / `verifyText` / `button` `count` |
| `move` / `drag` / `scroll` | Pointer movement | `x` `y` / `x2` `y2` / `amount` |
| `type` | Paste text | `text` / `window` / `verify` |
| `key` | Key combo, e.g. `ctrl+s` | `key` |
| `activate` | Bring a window to the front | `window` |
| `pos` / `wait` | Cursor position / sleep | — / `waitMs` |
| `sequence` | Several steps in one call | `steps` |

After installing, open **Settings → Visual safety** (a top-level entry in the settings
panel's left navigation, right below Plugins) to edit the policy directly:

- enable/disable the content policy
- dangerous labels, sensitive windows, irreversible labels (one per line)
- irreversible mode: ask / deny / allow
- refused key combos and the sequence depth limit

Saving writes the current profile's plugin config and takes effect on the next tool call — no
restart. Editing `cordis.patch.yml` still works the same way.

> After the first install, refresh the Harness page (Ctrl+R) once so the new client bundle loads and
> the tab appears.

```yaml
- id: visual-safety-control
  name: dsh-visual-safety-control
  config:
    policy:

The policy runs before PowerShell is spawned; the model cannot disable it through tool arguments. User lists replace the defaults.

| Option | Default | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `enabled` | `true` | `false` registers no tool |
| `powershellPath` | `powershell.exe` | PowerShell executable |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-call timeout |
| `screenshotDir` | `$DSH_HOME/desktop-control` | Where screenshots are saved |
| `screenshotMaxWidth` | `1440` | Long-edge cap |
| `screenshotGrid` / `screenshotCursor` | `false` / `true` | Coordinate grid / cursor mark |
| `keepShots` | `40` | Screenshots kept on disk |
| `elementsMaxRows` | `140` | `elements` row cap |
| `verifyType` / `verifyClick` | `true` | Verification defaults |

| Status | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- |
| `verified` | Readback contains the typed text, or `verifyText` found the expected content after the action |
| `unverified` | Readback worked but does not match, or the post-action text was not found |
| `unknown` | The action was delivered but the outcome cannot be machine-checked |
| `refused` | Not executed: wrong focus, foreground refused, hit-test mismatch, `expect` mismatch, or policy |

- Windows only, interactive desktop required; lock screen, UAC secure desktop and disconnected RDP sessions fail
- Coordinate clicks are not judged by the content policy; use `expect` / `verifyText`
- Short labels and similar glyphs can confuse OCR; use `exact` and `index`
- Irreversible actions default to `ask`; without host approval support they are denied
